submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Output one full-body transparent RGBA game sprite. Image 1 is the ONLY edit target: mountain guardian boy running diagonally away to upper-left, NW phase 1/16. Image 2 is another character used ONLY to understand a rear-view support boot's heel/toe perspective, NOT an approved pose template and never copy her character. Images 3,4 lock mountain guardian identity and NW camera; image 5 locks polished painterly Q-daoist game style.
Change ONLY the brown-gold boot and ankle on the SCREEN-RIGHT leg of image 1. Its current toe points sideways screen-right, an erroneous outward ankle yaw. Reorient this foot so the longitudinal heel-to-toe axis aims AWAY from camera toward UPPER-LEFT, matching travel and the shin. Show rounded rear heel toward viewer/lower-right; toe box foreshortens away upper-left under the shin, not sticking to the right. Draw correct natural boot structure, green ankle beads and gold trim. Keep its first-contact pose and footprint position.
Keep both knee positions, hips, exact leg spacing, other raised boot and its sole, arm poses, grip, complete single straight full-length staff from solid gold crown to lower pointed ferrule, staff tassel, shield, head/hair size, clothing, anatomy, camera, composition, canvas padding and all other pixels visually unchanged. Do NOT shorten or duplicate staff, do NOT change the movement phase, do NOT move feet closer together. Solid crown/backplate; only small jade ring has alpha hole. No ground plane, glow, text, shadow, extra objects. Genuine transparent background; at least 1024 square.
